info.name: Servio (Klick-Pro) Complete API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive, end-to-end API collection for Servio / Klick-Pro marketplace platform. Includes Authentication, Client Workspace, Professional Workspace, Shared Project Tracking & Portal, Wallet & Razorpay Escrow, Marketplace, KYC/Verification, Admin Suite, and Background Webhooks/Cron.
